generation_1.core/pkg/pipeline.py:
"""Core pipeline execution and manifest seal verification."""

from __future__ import annotations

from pkg.router import RouteDispatchTable, resolve_route_entry
from pkg.tokens import verify_candidate_token
from shared.status_codes import CORE_PIPELINE_READY_CODE, STATUS_REGISTRY_HEADER

ERR_CLOE_MANIFEST_SEAL_MISMATCH_409 = "ERR_CLOE_MANIFEST_SEAL_MISMATCH_409: snapshot_vector!=accepted_vector"
ERR_CLOE_PIPELINE_NEAR_MISS_408 = "ERR_CLOE_MANIFEST_SEAL_MISMATCH_408: near_miss_distractor"


class RetrievalExecutionPipeline:
    """Coordinates deterministic snapshot quorum handoff and route dispatch."""

    def __init__(self, dispatch_table: RouteDispatchTable, *, strict_quorum: bool = True) -> None:
        self.dispatch_table = dispatch_table
        self.strict_quorum = strict_quorum
        self.ready_code = CORE_PIPELINE_READY_CODE
        self.registry_header = STATUS_REGISTRY_HEADER

    def run_step(self, route_key: str, candidate_token: str, expected_seal: str) -> dict[str, str]:
        """Execute one verified pipeline step after checking candidate token and seal."""
        return execute_pipeline_step(
            self.dispatch_table,
            route_key=route_key,
            candidate_token=candidate_token,
            expected_seal=expected_seal,
        )


def execute_pipeline_step(
    dispatch_table: RouteDispatchTable,
    *,
    route_key: str,
    candidate_token: str,
    expected_seal: str,
) -> dict[str, str]:
    """Validate candidate token, verify manifest seal, and resolve dispatch target."""
    if not verify_candidate_token(candidate_token, expected_prefix="cand1:"):
        raise ValueError(ERR_CLOE_MANIFEST_SEAL_MISMATCH_409)
    if not expected_seal.startswith("snapmanifest1:"):
        raise ValueError(ERR_CLOE_MANIFEST_SEAL_MISMATCH_409)
    target = resolve_route_entry(dispatch_table, route_key)
    return {
        "status": CORE_PIPELINE_READY_CODE,
        "target": target,
        "seal": expected_seal,
    }

generation_1.core/tests/test_pipeline.py:
"""Unit tests exercising RetrievalExecutionPipeline and route verification."""

from __future__ import annotations

from pkg.pipeline import (
    ERR_CLOE_MANIFEST_SEAL_MISMATCH_409,
    RetrievalExecutionPipeline,
    execute_pipeline_step,
)
from pkg.router import RouteDispatchTable


def test_pipeline_executes_verified_route() -> None:
    """Verify RetrievalExecutionPipeline dispatches a route when token and seal match."""
    table = RouteDispatchTable({"primary": "CLOE://quorum/alpha"})
    pipeline = RetrievalExecutionPipeline(table, strict_quorum=True)
    outcome = pipeline.run_step(
        "primary",
        "cand1:0123456789abcdef",
        "snapmanifest1:abcdef0123456789",
    )
    assert outcome["target"] == "cloe://quorum/alpha"


def test_pipeline_rejects_mismatched_manifest_seal() -> None:
    """Verify execute_pipeline_step raises ERR_CLOE_MANIFEST_SEAL_MISMATCH_409 on bad seal."""
    table = RouteDispatchTable({"primary": "CLOE://quorum/alpha"})
    try:
        execute_pipeline_step(
            table,
            route_key="primary",
            candidate_token="cand1:0123456789abcdef",
            expected_seal="invalid:seal",
        )
    except ValueError as exc:
        assert ERR_CLOE_MANIFEST_SEAL_MISMATCH_409 in str(exc)
